name: Alpha Reaction Diffusion RGBA
description: Two competing four-chemical ecosystems in a single RGBA field. Bass makes predators more aggressive, mids increase competition between ecosystems, treble triggers spore-like bursts. Mouse acts as a keystone species that can trigger localized extinction and recovery events. Depth creates vertical stratification in diffusion rates.

params.name: Nutrient Availability
params.description: How much raw material is available for both ecosystems to grow

params.name: Predation Pressure
params.description: Base aggression of predators (further amplified by bass)

params.name: Ecosystem Competition
params.description: How fiercely the two separate ecosystems suppress each other (mids increase this)

params.name: Source Nutrients
params.description: How much the input image/video feeds the simulation as extra nutrients
